race.description: Go Hire The Event People C,G&E Mdn Hcp
race.comment: VATICAN (3) returned for his second campaign over the unsuitable trip with a plugging third over 1100m at Canterbury in a Super Maiden. Blinkers go on today from the right draw and looks to find his race with J Mac retaining the ride. ZAHAV (8) three-year-old gelding by Ghaiyyath from Testimonial on debut for the Maher stable. Has been given plenty of time to develop and looked to have plenty up the sleeve with the recent Gosford trial win over 1000m. Blinkers go on from the rails draw, leading player. LACONIC LIVO (7) was slow into stride second up and never looked a threat with a battling fifth over 1100m at Canterbury. Finds a suitable assignment with the blinkers being applied. Assess on the good first-up effort. ANGEL HAIR (1) Harry Angel gelding from Teenage Tale on debut for the Matt Smith yard. Trialled okay and the scratchings look to help. Keep safe.
